records.scope: Flask application implementing the leagueoflegends.com mirror: riotbar navigation, homepage hero and role/mode sections, the 173-champion roster with search/role/difficulty filters and sort, champion detail pages (abilities tab with ability art, Available Skins carousel), the News hub with category pages and paginated article grid, full article pages including patch-notes rich text, a patch-notes listing, the How To Play overview, the PBE page, the League of Legends Classic surface (the /classic/ landing page with its upstream sections — what-is features, teaser, featured news, Return to the Rift, you-choose, Riot Account, FAQ, newsletter and final CTA — and /classic/champions/ with the 68-champion classic tile grid linking to the mirror's champion pages), site-wide scored search, and the Riot-account surface (signup, login, account dashboard, favorite champions, saved articles, profile editing). Route and URL patterns and page structure follow the upstream site.

Deterministic build-time and boot-time seeder. Champion/ability/skin/article rows come from the tracked source_data.json snapshot; benchmark-user favorites and bookmarks are generated with random.Random(42) and a stable sha256 password hash so the SQLite seed is byte-reproducible on every build.

Tracked snapshot of the live site's structured data, harvested 2026-09-22 via Playwright from the Next.js __NEXT_DATA__ payloads the live pages serve: 173 champions (names, epithets, roles, difficulty, lore), 865 abilities (slot, name, description), 2118 skins (names), 270 internal news articles (titles, summaries, authors, tags, publish dates, full rich-text bodies including 16 patch-notes articles), 154 external news link cards, and 10 news categories. Release ordering uses Riot's numeric champion keys extracted from the upstream ability-video URLs.

2291 real images: 173 champion portraits exactly as the roster grid renders them (cmsassets.rgpub.io sanity images at the w=312 size the live grid requests) and 2118 champion/skin splash arts (ddragon.leagueoflegends.com/cdn/img/champion/splash). Per-file byte counts, SHA-256 digests and source URLs are recorded in asset_inventory.json. Three Fiddlesticks carousel entries referenced by the live site (Fiddlesticks_27/37/46) 403 upstream even on leagueoflegends.com and are omitted rather than shipped broken.

1716 real images: 865 ability icons (ddragon /img/passive and /img/spell) and 851 ability preview stills (the video poster frames from lol.dyn.riotcdn.net the upstream ability media panel plays). Fourteen ability preview URLs 404 upstream (e.g. ryze/vladimir/volibear passives); those media panels fall back to the ability icon.

3530 real images: 270 article masthead banners (cmsassets at the w=1440 size the live article masthead requests), 424 grid card images (h=240 w=427 crop, as rendered by the live news grids, including the 154 external link cards), and 2836 inline body images from the article rich-text bodies (cmsassets.rgpub.io illustrations, ddragon/am-a.akamaihd.net champion and spell icons, and the animated GIFs the live articles embed). Inline bodies were rewritten to the local copies; every file lists its exact upstream URL in asset_inventory.json. Three inline URLs are dead upstream (the 2018 LPP-LBChroma.jpg that 400s and two nexus.leagueoflegends.com WordPress uploads that now return an HTML error page) and were dropped from their article bodies together with their img tags.

42 real site-chrome and landing images: the League of Legends logo and hero backdrops, the six champion role tiles and four game-mode tiles from the homepage, the skins promo art, the How To Play section art (nexus/turret/jungle/lane/ability tiles, champion tiles), the ESRB rating mark and the Riot fist mark.

98 real images for the League of Legends Classic surface: 30 landing-page assets (hero backdrop, what-is features, teaser stills, featured-news card crops, section backdrops and ornaments, newsletter art and video still, final-CTA art) fetched from cmsassets.rgpub.io at the exact sizes the upstream classic page requests, and 68 champion tile portraits from ddragon's mode/classic tile set (Jade_<Champion> renditions) as the upstream /classic/champions/ grid renders them. Per-file byte counts, SHA-256 digests and source URLs are recorded in asset_inventory.json.

Original Jinja templates and CSS implementing the leagueoflegends.com visual system (riotbar black #111111 with Inter-style nav, LoL navy #0A1428 palette, gold #C8AA6E accents, Beaufort-style italic uppercase mastheads, card grids, patch-notes tables) without copying the upstream stylesheet or fonts.

Build-time only (gitignored, dockerignored): Playwright captures of the live leagueoflegends.com pages (homepage, roster, 173 champion pages, news hub and category pages, 270 article pages, how-to-play), the harvest/download scripts, and the download manifest that records every upstream source URL.

Harvest pipeline scripts: harvest.py (Playwright recon + structured extraction), fetch_images.py (upstream image downloader + manifest writer), build_source_data.py (source_data.json builder with inline-image rewriting). Not part of the runtime mirror.

30 contributor-defined benchmark tasks over the mirror's roster filters, champion detail facts, skin catalogs, patch notes, news categories, site search, and the seeded benchmark users' account state.
Mirror scope, provenance summary and takedown contact for Riot Games and partner marks.
